state_history.note: Spec gate approved by Sam in session; plan artifacts authored.

Three lenses ran; all returned request_changes. Two verified HIGH (SPEC-001, SEC-001) forced the one permitted re-plan cycle; 17 further findings applied in the same pass. Task ids renumbered, 43 tasks.
S3R round 2: spec-compliance approve, security request_changes with one verified HIGH (SEC-101). Design-review budget 1/1 exhausted, so the second red round escalates rather than re-plans.
S3R closed clean after a Sam-authorised second re-plan cycle and a third security round. All three lenses satisfied; ready for the plan notification and S4.
Spec amendment (D24) approved by Sam via delta brief; T043 released. S4 begins with the US1 foundational phase.

self_resolved: Rendering is generic; the configured view covers one parent with one related set.
One related set per page; a multi-set page composes the rendering components.
Removing a row defers to submission via Django's DELETE flag.
Parent and rows save atomically, stated as a requirement rather than assumed of the database.
Creating a parent alongside its first rows is covered, not only editing.
The worked example is written against the demo application.

AMENDED 2026-08-05 and re-approved by Sam in session: the Assumption reserving R12's list-page dependency is struck through and refined. This feature settles the whole of R12's undeclared-dependency deliverable (its second, not its first), because both pages load the same distribution. R12 keeps the unguarded module-level import, the absent form renderer setting, and the optional-dependency check. Delta brief sent and approved before implementation; T043 released.

SEC-002 — Alpine loaded from a CDN at a floating version with no subresource integrity. Pre-existing and wider than this feature; carried as a named risk in plan.md and filed as its own issue rather than fixed on this branch.
SPEC-101 — the R12 scope Assumption was amended in spec.md via a dated strikethrough refinement (D24) rather than a quiet plan edit; it goes to Sam as a delta brief.

escalations.reason: Design-review budget exhausted with security still red. SEC-101 (verified high): the absolute_max half of the round-1 SEC-001 remedy rejects legitimate submissions and drops submitted rows, contradicting D18's monotonic TOTAL_FORMS and FR-013. SEC-102 (verified medium): the specified form_valid re-enters ModelFormMixin and saves the parent twice. SPEC-101 (verified medium): spec.md's Assumptions reserve a list-page dependency for R12 that this feature in fact resolves, so the R12 annotation needs a spec amendment and a re-gate.
escalations.resolution: Sam authorised a second re-plan cycle on 2026-08-05 rather than treating the escalation as a spec failure, on the reading that both blocking findings were defects in the round-1 remedy and both fixes were subtractive. Applied in full, including a gated spec amendment (D24). Round 3 of the security lens confirmed SEC-101/102/103 closed and found one regression from the round-2 remedy (SEC-201), which was fixed and re-verified. Panel now clean: spec-compliance approve, security approve, architecture raised no blocking finding.
